preconditions.description: The number of passwords n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of failed tries k must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(password) <= 100 for password in passwords)
preconditions.description: Each password must be a non-empty string with a length between 1 and 100 characters.
The Codehorses password must be one of the provided passwords.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the best case time and worst case time separated by a space.
The best case time must be at least 1 second.
The worst case time must be greater than or equal to the best case time.
